note: Sub-milestone High-Precision Primitive Estimation. Settings fixed on the TUNING keys 1090-1095 only, before the launch of the AWS runs. Only band_factor and cos_normal were chosen on a measurement (recall of the true curves at 300 and 600 observations); the other values are the default values, not swept. The out-of-sample validation requires a significant gain (paired test, z >= 1.64): without this threshold, the procedure was accepted on random labels (unit test).
